The core mechanism propagates a complex field $U_h(x,y)$ defined on the hologram plane to a reconstruction plane at distance $z$.

**Angular Spectrum Method (ASM):** Exact for scalar diffraction, valid for near-field.

**Fresnel Method:** Approximation for far-field or paraxial regimes.
A post-processing step applied after the absolute value extraction of the reconstructed wavefield.
